claims.claim: The documented native NVFP4 recipe accounts for 0.5 bytes packed data plus 1/16 byte block scale per scalar, giving a theoretical BF16-to-NVFP4 token-capacity ratio of about 3.56x before other workspace effects

claims.claim: Native NVFP4 prefill has architecture and shape constraints and does not support every speculative algorithm, PD disaggregation, HiCache or LMCache
